summary: Quantum Corporation filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026, reporting that CFO and Principal Financial Officer William H. White was terminated effective immediately, with Chief Accounting Officer Hiral A. Patel (38, in the role since September 1, 2026) appointed Principal Financial Officer the same day. The company stated no operational disruption is expected and reaffirmed on-time filing of its September 30, 2026 Form 10-Q; no advisor, severance terms or board recommendation were disclosed. Separately, Item 2.02 indicated quarterly results should meet or exceed prior guidance. Watch for 10-Q timing, any severance or restatement risk, and disclosed reasons for the abrupt departure.
